Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 139. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 12
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (100 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
The Famous Turtle Destruction Wave developed by
Muten Roshi.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 100 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 3d10 ki damage on a
fail, half on a success.
